description: EPA AgSTAR Livestock Anaerobic Digester Database, sheet 'Shutdown': farm-scale digesters with one animal type, no co-digestion and a recorded 'Reason for Closure'. economics = the recorded reason is cost, price, payback, revenue or bankruptcy (keyword rule in this file's generator, reviewed by hand); fires, structural or design failures and farm closures are not economics. Reasons are AgSTAR's compilation from voluntary sources. The model is run at today's prices, not those of the closure year.

rows.name: Bullfrog Dairy Digester
rows.reason: Shut dairy

rows.name: Cal Poly Dairy Digester
rows.reason: No operator

rows.name: CAL-Denier Dairy Digester
rows.reason: According to Dec 2017 CDFA presentation (by Casey Walsh Cady), Denier Dairy project listed as "temporarily offline."_x000D_ According to Martin Const (Aug 2019) shut down digester is operable but poor payback keeps it offline.

rows.name: Eden-Vale Dairy Digester
rows.reason: Economic. Operable, but poor buyback.

rows.name: Koetsier Dairy Digester
rows.reason: Air-quality standards calling for expensive retrofits to reduce air pollution led to shutdown. _x000D_ Dairy closed.

rows.name: Langerwerf Dairy Digester
rows.reason: Farm sold.

rows.name: Meadowbrook Dairy Digester
rows.reason: Shut dairy.

rows.name: Futura Dairy-Waubeek Dairy Cow Farm Digester
rows.reason: The dairy operations ceased.

rows.name: Thaler Farm Digester
rows.reason: Owner left business.

rows.name: Whitesides Dairy Digester
rows.reason: Intrepid bankrupt.

rows.name: Prairie's Edge Dairy Site 1 Digester

rows.name: Fairgrove Farms, Inc. Digester

rows.name: Riverview Dairy Digester - Electricity

rows.name: West River Dairy Digester - Electricity

rows.name: OLean Energy Digester
rows.reason: Unable to sustain sufficient biogas output

rows.name: EL-VI Farms Digester

rows.name: Emerling Farms Digester
rows.reason: Cost to own and operate system exceeded revenue/benefits.

rows.name: Farber Farm/NYC Watershed Ag Council (WAC) Digester
rows.reason: Cows were sold so there is no manure to feed the digester.

rows.name: Noblehurst Farms Digester: original system
rows.reason: A fire destroyed the genset and structure holding all the equipment.

rows.name: Threemile Canyon Farms Digester: demonstration
rows.reason: 18 month demo project only. New digester built.

rows.name: Broumley Dairy Farm Digester: Earlier System
rows.reason: The sytem will be reconfigured to be more economical for farmer.

rows.name: Martin Farms Digester
rows.reason: The digester cover and PVC frame deteriorated to the point of necessary removal. New owner.

rows.name: Foster Brothers Farms Digester
rows.reason: Roof collapse.

rows.name: Joneslan Farm Digester
rows.reason: Faulty mixing design (prototype digester); multiple manure handling failures, including freezing pipes; insufficient support

rows.name: Keewaydin Farm Digester
rows.reason: Faulty mixing design (prototype digester); lack of company support (company defunct)

rows.name: Nordic Farm Digester
rows.reason: The system needs a new manure feed pump. Circa 2020: farm repurposed into agriculture and food business incubator, cows sold.

rows.name: North Williston Cattle Company Digester
rows.reason: Structural failure of attached-growth media in a prototype system.

rows.name: Riverview Farm Digester
rows.reason: Engine corrosion from lack of H2S control. Lack of support from genset provider (2G Energy) and digester company.

rows.name: Double S Dairy Digester
rows.reason: The digester was too small and the utility interconnect fee too high (and rates too low) for project expansion.

rows.name: Lake Breeze Dairy Digester
rows.reason: There was a fire in the engine/ control panel/ separator building.

rows.name: Quantum Dairy Digester
rows.reason: Clint Fandrich indicated that the farm suffered a catastrophic fire in 2012. The owners see great value in the digester and wil look to bring the system back online in the coming years.

rows.name: Stencil Farm Digester
rows.reason: The digester experienced difficulty in keeping within the target operational temperature range, so the project switched to composting.

rows.name: Wyoming Premium Farms 2 Digester
rows.reason: Farm not operating.
